question: How do I mark a lesson as complete on Savanna?
question_en: How do I mark a lesson as complete on Savanna?
question_am: በሳቫና ላይ ትምህርትን እንደተጠናቀቀ እንዴት ምልክት ማድረግ እችላለሁ?
answer: At the bottom of each concept or lesson page, click the 'Mark as complete' button. Your progress bar in the top navigation will automatically update.
answer_en: At the bottom of each concept or lesson page, click the 'Mark as complete' button. Your progress bar in the top navigation will automatically update.
answer_am: በእያንዳንዱ ፅንሰ-ሀሳብ ወይም የትምህርት ገጽ ግርጌ ላይ 'Mark as complete' የሚለውን ቁልፍ ጠቅ ያድርጉ። በከፍተኛ ዳሰሳ ውስጥ ያለው የሂደት አሞሌዎ ወዲያውኑ ይዘምናል::

question: Does granting screen capture start a live call with a human immediately?
question_en: Does granting screen capture start a live call with a human immediately?
question_am: የማያ ገጽ ቀረጻን መፍቀድ ወዲያውኑ ከሰው ጋር የቀጥታ ጥሪ ይጀምራል?
answer: No. A local screen-capture preview only renders your screen locally in your browser for you to verify what is visible. No live human connection is established, and your screen is never transmitted without your separate, explicit consent and an active agent session.
answer_en: No. A local screen-capture preview only renders your screen locally in your browser for you to verify what is visible. No live human connection is established, and your screen is never transmitted without your separate, explicit consent and an active agent session.
answer_am: አይደለም። የአካባቢ ማያ ገጽ ቀረጻ ቅድመ-ዕይታ የሚታየውን ለማረጋገጥ ብቻ በአሳሽዎ ውስጥ በአካባቢው ያሳያል። ምንም የቀጥታ የሰው ግንኙነት አይመሰረትም፣ እና ያለእርስዎ ግልጽ ፈቃድ ማያ ገጽዎ አይተላለፍም።

question: What is the Voice4All Simulated Support queue?
question_en: What is the Voice4All Simulated Support queue?
question_am: የ Voice4All የማስመሰል ድጋፍ ሰልፍ ምንድን ነው?
answer: Voice4All provides a simulated helpdesk workflow for hackathon testing and learner onboarding. When you submit a support ticket, it enters a simulated queue with estimated response times and mock triage. Live peer and staff escalation is available during scheduled office hours.
answer_en: Voice4All provides a simulated helpdesk workflow for hackathon testing and learner onboarding. When you submit a support ticket, it enters a simulated queue with estimated response times and mock triage. Live peer and staff escalation is available during scheduled office hours.
answer_am: Voice4All ለሙከራ እና ለተማሪዎች ዝግጅት የማስመሰል የእገዛ ዴስክ የስራ ፍሰት ያቀርባል። የድጋፍ ጥያቄ ሲያቀርቡ፣ ከተገመቱ የምላሽ ጊዜዎች ጋር የማስመሰል ሰልፍ ውስጥ ይገባል።

question: What accessibility options are supported in Voice4All?
question_en: What accessibility options are supported in Voice4All?
question_am: በ Voice4All ውስጥ ምን ዓይነት የተደራሽነት አማራጮች ይደገፋሉ?
answer: Voice4All supports voice-driven curriculum navigation, high-contrast themes, dyslexia-friendly fonts, screen-reader optimized headings, and automated lesson summarization.
answer_en: Voice4All supports voice-driven curriculum navigation, high-contrast themes, dyslexia-friendly fonts, screen-reader optimized headings, and automated lesson summarization.
answer_am: Voice4All በድምፅ የሚመራ የስርዓተ-ትምህርት ዳሰሳ፣ ከፍተኛ የንፅፅር ገጽታዎች፣ ለንባብ ምቹ ቅርጸ-ቁምፊዎች እና ራስ-ሰር የትምህርት ማጠቃለያዎችን ይደግፋል።

question: Can I draft workplace accommodation requests before an interview?
question_en: Can I draft workplace accommodation requests before an interview?
question_am: ከቃለ መጠይቅ በፊት የስራ ቦታ ማመቻቸት ጥያቄዎችን ማርቀቅ እችላለሁ?
answer: Yes. The Career module allows you to select relevant accommodations (such as screen reader friendly task boards or flexible asynchronous check-ins) and generate a polished draft. Drafts remain private and are never sent directly to employers.
answer_en: Yes. The Career module allows you to select relevant accommodations (such as screen reader friendly task boards or flexible asynchronous check-ins) and generate a polished draft. Drafts remain private and are never sent directly to employers.
answer_am: አዎ። የሙያ ክፍሉ ተገቢ የሆኑ ማመቻቸቶችን እንዲመርጡ እና የተስተካከለ ረቂቅ እንዲያዘጋጁ ያስችልዎታል። ረቂቆች ሚስጥራዊ ሆነው ይቆያሉ እና በቀጥታ ለአሰሪዎች አይላኩም።

question: How does the curriculum switcher work?
question_en: How does the curriculum switcher work?
answer: Click the program dropdown in the top header (e.g. 'VA-1: VA Foundations & Professional Identity') to view other registered courses, track average scores, or switch between modules.
answer_en: Click the program dropdown in the top header (e.g. 'VA-1: VA Foundations & Professional Identity') to view other registered courses, track average scores, or switch between modules.
answer_am: ሌሎች የተመዘገቡ ኮርሶችን ለማየት፣ አማካይ ውጤቶችን ለመከታተል ወይም በሞጁሎች መካከል ለመቀያየር በከፍተኛ ራስጌ ላይ ያለውን የፕሮግራም ተቆልቋይ ዝርዝር ጠቅ ያድርጉ።

lessonTitle: The Future of the VA Industry
question: Is the virtual assistant profession shrinking or growing?
question_en: Is the virtual assistant profession shrinking or growing?
question_am: የቨርቹዋል ረዳት ሙያ እየቀነሰ ነው ወይስ እያደገ?
answer: The Virtual Assistant profession is not shrinking; it is evolving. Businesses are becoming more digital and distributed, which significantly increases demand for skilled, remote support professionals.
answer_en: The Virtual Assistant profession is not shrinking; it is evolving. Businesses are becoming more digital and distributed, which significantly increases demand for skilled, remote support professionals.
answer_am: የቨርቹዋል ረዳት ሙያ እየቀነሰ አይደለም፤ ይልቁንም እያደገ እና እየዘመነ ነው። የንግድ ድርጅቶች ይበልጥ ዲጂታል ሲሆኑ የሰለጠኑ የርቀት ረዳቶች ፍላጎት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየጨመረ ነው።

lessonTitle: An Important Distinction: AI vs Human VAs
question: What is the difference between an AI assistant and a human virtual assistant?
question_en: What is the difference between an AI assistant and a human virtual assistant?
question_am: በ AI ረዳት እና በሰው ቨርቹዋል ረዳት መካከል ያለው ልዩነት ምንድን ነው?
answer: An AI assistant is automated software (such as chatbots and digital bots) handling routine computations. A human virtual assistant is a remote professional who uses strategic judgment, empathy, emotional intelligence, and discretion to solve business challenges.
answer_en: An AI assistant is automated software (such as chatbots and digital bots) handling routine computations. A human virtual assistant is a remote professional who uses strategic judgment, empathy, emotional intelligence, and discretion to solve business challenges.
answer_am: የ AI ረዳት ማለት እንደ ቻትቦት ያለ አውቶሜትድ ሶፍትዌር ሲሆን፣ የሰው ቨርቹዋል ረዳት ግን ስትራቴጂካዊ ውሳኔዎችን፣ ስሜታዊ ብልህነትን እና ርህራሄን ተጠቅሞ የንግድ ችግሮችን የሚፈታ እውነተኛ የሰው ባለሙያ ነው።

lessonTitle: Artificial Intelligence in VA Work and Human Superpowers
question: How can AI tools support virtual assistants in their daily tasks?
question_en: How can AI tools support virtual assistants in their daily tasks?
question_am: የ AI መሣሪያዎች ቨርቹዋል ረዳቶችን በእለት ተእለት ስራቸው እንዴት ሊረዷቸው ይችላሉ?
answer: AI tools accelerate repetitive work such as drafting first-pass emails, summarizing meeting transcripts, organizing workflows, conducting initial research, and calendar scheduling.
answer_en: AI tools accelerate repetitive work such as drafting first-pass emails, summarizing meeting transcripts, organizing workflows, conducting initial research, and calendar scheduling.
answer_am: የ AI መሣሪያዎች የመጀመሪያ ረቂቅ ኢሜይሎችን በማዘጋጀት፣ የስብሰባ ማስታወሻዎችን በማጠቃለል፣ የስራ ፍሰቶችን በማደራጀት እና ፈጣን ጥናት በማድረግ ይረዳሉ።

lessonTitle: Artificial Intelligence in VA Work and Human Superpowers
question: Where do human virtual assistants still add the most value over AI?
question_en: Where do human virtual assistants still add the most value over AI?
question_am: የሰው ቨርቹዋል ረዳቶች ከ AI በላይ ከፍተኛ ዋጋ የሚሰጡት በየትኞቹ ዘርፎች ነው?
answer: Human VAs excel in relationship management, emotional intelligence, navigating ambiguity, ethical confidentiality, team coordination, and proactive system improvement.
answer_en: Human VAs excel in relationship management, emotional intelligence, navigating ambiguity, ethical confidentiality, team coordination, and proactive system improvement.
answer_am: የሰው ረዳቶች የደንበኛ ግንኙነትን በመንከባከብ፣ በስሜታዊ ብልህነት፣ ያልተጠበቁ ሁኔታዎችን በማስተናገድ፣ ሚስጥር በመጠበቅ እና ስርዓቶችን በማሻሻል የማይተካ ሚና አላቸው።

question: What is active listening?
question_am: ንቁ ማዳመጥ ማለት ምን ማለት ነው?
answer: Active listening is fully concentrating on, understanding, paraphrasing, and responding thoughtfully to a speaker rather than passively hearing them.
answer_en: Active listening is fully concentrating on, understanding, paraphrasing, and responding thoughtfully to a speaker rather than passively hearing them.
answer_am: ንቁ ማዳመጥ (Active listening) ተናጋሪው የሚናገረውን በዝምታ ከመስማት ይልቅ ሙሉ ትኩረትን መስጠት፣ መረዳት፣ በራስ ቃል መግለጽ እና ተገቢ ምላሽ መስጠት ነው።

lessonTitle: Structuring Clear Workplace Messages & The BLUF Model
question: What is the BLUF model in communication?
question_en: What is the BLUF model in communication?
question_am: በግንኙነት ውስጥ የ BLUF ሞዴል ምንድን ነው?
answer: BLUF stands for Bottom Line Up Front. It is a communication technique where you state the main purpose, request, or recommendation in the first two sentences.
answer_en: BLUF stands for Bottom Line Up Front. It is a communication technique where you state the main purpose, request, or recommendation in the first two sentences.
answer_am: BLUF ማለት 'Bottom Line Up Front' ወይም ዋናውን መልእክት ወይም ጥያቄ ወዲያውኑ በመጀመሪያዎቹ ሁለት አረፍተ ነገሮች ውስጥ ማስቀደም የሚያስችል የአጻጻፍ ዘዴ ነው።

lessonTitle: Course Progression, Milestone Grading & Graduation Threshold
question: What is the passing score or graduation threshold?
question_en: What is the passing score or graduation threshold?
answer: To successfully graduate from the programme, learners must achieve an overall course score of at least 70% across all milestone evaluations, quizzes, and deliverables.
answer_en: To successfully graduate from the programme, learners must achieve an overall course score of at least 70% across all milestone evaluations, quizzes, and deliverables.
answer_am: ትምህርቱን አጠናቀው ለመመረቅ ተማሪዎች በሁሉም ምዕራፎች፣ ፈተናዎች እና ምዘናዎች ቢያንስ 70% አጠቃላይ ውጤት ማምጣት አለባቸው።

question: Why is client confidentiality so critical for a virtual assistant?
question_en: Why is client confidentiality so critical for a virtual assistant?
question_am: ለቨርቹዋል ረዳት የደንበኛ ሚስጥር መጠበቅ ለምን አስፈላጊ ሆነ?
answer: Confidentiality protects proprietary corporate data, passwords, and client privacy. It forms the essential foundation of professional trust in remote partnerships.
answer_en: Confidentiality protects proprietary corporate data, passwords, and client privacy. It forms the essential foundation of professional trust in remote partnerships.
answer_am: የደንበኛ ሚስጥራዊነት የንግድ ድርጅቱን መረጃ እና የግል ደህንነት የሚጠብቅ ሲሆን የሙያዊ እምነት እና ዘላቂ አጋርነት መሰረት ነው።
